rename.from: Component templates are considered invalid with timestamp_field
rename.to: Component templates are considered invalid without timestamp_field

body: @martijnvg I believe this is fixed as part of #58642, but I also think we discussed perhaps not doing that PR, do you know whether we plan to merge that and then make the changes related to hardcoding the name we discussed, or whether we need to fix this separately?

@dakrone I would expect that in this example the composable index template can be added without an error, because the timestamp field mapping has been defined inside the template. The empty component template shouldn't have to define the timestamp field mapping, right?

There are going to be a two changes:
* The timestamp field for a data stream is going to be fixed to be '@timestamp', until we figure out what would be the best way to make this field configurable (or at least make sure that the timestamp itself can be provided via another field).
* If no field mapping is going to be provided for the '@timestamp' field then a default mapping should be applied. This is what #58642 is doing. Since #58642 is doing more than that, I will extract that particular piece of the pr and open a new pr, once the first change has been merged.

and #58642 fixes the bug here: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/58642/files#diff-115cd2f0fff9dd97acc95e1d29012a15R1080

For each template the timestamp field was validated, whereas instead this should be validated 
for the final mappings.

I will address that in the pr that fixes the timestamp field to `@timestamp`

issue.title: Fix the timestamp field of a data stream to @timestamp

issue.body:
The commit makes the following changes:
* The timestamp field of a data stream definition in a composable
  index template can only be set to `@timestamp`.
* Removed custom data stream timestamp field validation and reuse the validation from `TimestampFieldMapper` and
  instead only check that the _timestamp field mapping has been defined on a backing index of a data stream.
* Moved code that injects _timestamp meta field mapping from `MetadataCreateIndexService#applyCreateIndexRequestWithV2Template(...)` method
  to `MetadataIndexTemplateService#collectMappings(...)` method.
* Fixed a bug (#58956) that cases timestamp field validation to be performed
  for each template and instead of the final mappings that is created.

Relates to #58642
Relates to #53100
Closes #58956
Closes #58583
